previous_development_failures: normal001 through014 remain unaccepted; different source/model configurations remain separate. Normal014 high-level native two-goal proposal valid; two malformed low-level flat action replies were rejected before input. Its actual wait1 and raw records are preserved.
explicit_design_change: Model-proposed intermediate literal postconditions are untrusted predictions. The v5 caller-final-only enum/membership and pool-specific caller count/length preflight restrictions are removed. No local plan authoring/merging or forced two-goal skeleton.
caller: Unchanged full natural-language instruction and three caller-final checks constructed by scripts/week6_semantic_acceptance.py. No milestone vocabulary or goal sequence supplied by the program.
required_evidence: Initial native plan >=2 distinct meaningful objectives and exact raw-to-compiled origin
Each completed goal contract fixed before input, full predicate false on fresh before, confirmed real input, fresh verified post
No failed/unknown/cancel rescue, no completed-goal replay, shared budgets
Fresh immutable caller-final independent of model conditions
Independent project/theme/review/commit events in exact order with one unique actual Sky receipt per event
Actual owner wait0, unchanged pinned code and separate v6 machine auditor
Root agent reviews each native instruction against its actual business transitions; no human sign-off is claimed
limits: Before-false/after-true literal evidence alone is not semantic proof. Casefold substring is not a general negation recognizer. Future labels may be guessed incorrectly and must then fail. These are two controlled functional cases, not an arbitrary-app success-rate study.
final_full_regression: Required after both accepted real cases; 3419 is only collection, full004 not started.
added_generic_grounding: Original-frame and refreshed-frame observable native text/ID conflicts are refused without dispatch or local ID replacement, with bounded replanning. Unique OCR labels may use native text-only targets. Same action/planning/HTTP/time budgets.
added_live_monitoring: Parent counts relay persisted child events before child return; semantic completion remains outer-ledger gated. Ordinary observer faults do not retry input; cancellation propagates. Status elapsed uses a separate monitor clock.
